status_note: Frozen 2026-11-05 after author approval in chat ("Freeze as drafted"). Definitions, gates, sample sizes and namespaces are fixed. SHA-256 of this file is in protocol.sha256. No campaign data generated at freeze.
drafted_by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5); the author decides the design

code_under_test.hashes: recorded in manifest_pregeneration.json before the first campaign draw

hypotheses.H-API: Through the package API, the refreshed sampler and the IID control both pass the Phase II healthy gates (G-R and G-I).
hypotheses.H-REP: Additionally, local Metropolis under-covers (F-L) and the refresh improves paired coverage by more than 0.10 (P-RL).

model.refresh: harmonic_centroid_heatbath once after every sweep, 16 bytes per draw

definitions.observable: CV = 1/(2 beta) + mean(x^2) - mean(x)^2/2, after every sweep including sweep 0
definitions.primary_interval: summarize_series(cv, reference=E_M, batch_sizes=(512,))['batch_means']['512']: 16 batches of 512, MCSE = sd(batch means)/4, mean +/- t(15, 0.975) MCSE, closed interval

data.namespace_search: unused in the repository and local Codex output folders, searched 2026-11-05
data.seed_rule: namespace_seed('rnglab-v018-api-validation', condition, role, f'{i:05d}') -> PCG64Source(seed); one source object per role

metropolis/start.note: drawn before the run; passed as initial_path and as the initialization channel (reads 0 bytes in the run)

data.start: sample_exact_finite_bead_paths(start_source, 16, 2.0, 2)[0]; initial_path_provenance = {namespace, condition, role, replica, seed, sampler}
data.pairing: local and refresh share start, proposal and acceptance seeds per replica (as Phase II); replicas independent across i

saved.traces: traces/<condition>/block-XXXX.npz outside Git: CV, TD, centroid, rg2 (float64, 8192 each) and start path per replica; SHA-256 in committed manifests
saved.paths: not saved; per-replica SHA-256 recorded; regenerable by deterministic replay
saved.committed: results/<condition>_replicas.csv: seeds, start SHA-256, acceptance rate, CV and TD mean, BM512 MCSE, interval, covered, bytes and final digest per role

analysis.coverage: covered count / R with Clopper-Pearson 95% interval
analysis.variance_ratio: mean over replicas of MCSE^2 / var(CV means, ddof=1); percentile bootstrap over replicas, 10000 resamples, seed namespace_seed(ns, 'analysis', 'bootstrap', endpoint)
analysis.bias: mean over replicas of (CV mean - E_M), t(R-1) 95% interval
analysis.paired_difference: d_i = covered_refresh_i - covered_local_i; mean with percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed namespace_seed(ns, 'analysis', 'bootstrap', 'paired')
analysis.exclusions: none; BM512 status other than ESTIMATED counts as not covered and is reported
analysis.pass_rule: conjunction of listed criteria; no multiplicity adjustment; chance-failure probabilities in design.json

implementation.I-1: per replica: proposal 1048576 bytes; initialization 0; centroid 131072 (refresh) or absent (local); iid paths 1048576; resampling absent; no aliases
implementation.I-2: per replica: local and refresh start SHA-256 equal, and equal to the regenerated start's digest
implementation.I-3: per replica: CV recomputed from recorded paths matches CV trace within 1e-12 absolute
implementation.I-4: replica 0 of each condition regenerated after the campaign gives an identical CV-trace SHA-256

gates.recount: separate script recomputes all 3 x R coverage events and gate statistics from saved CV traces with its own NumPy/SciPy code; all counts must agree

verdicts.H-API: supported iff G-R and G-I pass; otherwise failed (a finding; milestone complete once the discrepancy is localised with a minimal reproducer)
verdicts.H-REP: supported iff F-L and P-RL pass

secondary: TD BM512: coverage, variance ratio, bias, all conditions
CV with rnglab.longrun: BM(32), BM(128), OBM(512), SV-B(512), SV-TH(512), Geyer (sensitivity only: systematic scan is not reversible)
batch-length diagnostic on CV: status counts and adaptive-interval coverage; expectation recorded: local mostly RUN_TOO_SHORT, refresh and IID mostly adequate
between-replica variance of CV means split into centroid (mean(x)^2/2) and shape (rg2) parts plus twice their covariance
acceptance rate, Geyer tau-hat and ESS distributions
coverage difference API minus Phase II per condition with Wald 95% interval (descriptive)

resources.runtime: about 8600 single-core seconds at R=4096; about 36 min with 4 workers, one BLAS thread each (design.json runtime_projection)

excluded: other M, beta, delta, burn-in rules or non-stationary starts
the API's exact_gaussian mode as a separate condition

implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.note: Operational details not specified in the draft; fixed here before any campaign draw; no gate or endpoint changes.
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.storage: one compressed NPZ per (condition, block of 256 replicas) under research/v018-api-validation/traces/ (gitignored), SHA-256 in the run manifest; block b holds replicas 256b..256b+255
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.paths_sha256: SHA-256 of trace['paths'] as little-endian float64 bytes in C order (sweep-major)
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.I-3: evaluated in the worker before the paths are discarded; the per-replica maximum absolute difference is recorded
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.iid_secondary_traces: IID centroid and rg2 per path computed from the paths (bead mean; mean squared deviation from it) for the mechanism secondary
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.geyer_undefined: if GEYER returns INVALID_LONG_RUN_VARIANCE, the GEYER secondary interval counts as non-coverage and the diagnostic abstains with TAU_UNDEFINED, reported separately (as Phase 1)
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.parallelism: 4 worker processes (fork context), one task per (condition, block), OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; results do not depend on scheduling
